public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  let names be dependencies.keys().sorted()
  for each step in names
    let wanted be dependencies.get(step) otherwise []
    for each dep in wanted
      if not dependencies.contains_key(dep) then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: dep)
      end
    end
  end

  let mutable result: List of Text be []
  repeat until result.length() is at least names.length()
    let mutable ready: List of Text be []
    for each step in names
      if not result.contains(step) then
        let needed be dependencies.get(step) otherwise []
        let blocked be for each dep in needed any not result.contains(dep)
        if not blocked then
          set ready to ready.append(step)
        end
      end
    end
    match ready.first()
      when some(chosen) then
        set result to result.append(chosen)
      when nothing then
        let remaining be for each step in names where not result.contains(step) collect step
        fail with Cycle(remaining: remaining)
    end
  end
  return result
end

      if not dependencies.contains_key(dependency) then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: dependency)
      end
    end
  end

  let mutable result: List of Text be []
  let mutable remaining: List of Text be names
  repeat until remaining.is_empty()
    let mutable chosen: maybe Text be nothing
    for each candidate in remaining

        set remaining to for each item in remaining where item is not picked collect item
      when nothing then

public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  let names be dependencies.keys().sorted()
  for each name in names
    let listed be dependencies.get(name) otherwise crash with "unreachable: {name}"
    for each dep in listed.sorted()
      if not dependencies.contains_key(dep) then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: name, depends_on: dep)
      end
    end
  end

  let mutable placed: List of Text be []
  repeat until placed.length() is at least names.length()
    let mutable chosen: maybe Text be nothing
    for each candidate in names
      if not placed.contains(candidate) then
        let deps be dependencies.get(candidate) otherwise crash with "unreachable: {candidate}"
        let ready be for each dep in deps all placed.contains(dep)
        if ready and chosen is nothing then
          set chosen to candidate
        end
      end
    end
    match chosen
      when some(found) then
        set placed to placed.append(found)
      when nothing then
        let remaining be for each leftover in names where not placed.contains(leftover) collect leftover
        fail with Cycle(remaining: remaining)
    end
  end
  return placed
end

  let steps: List of Text be dependencies.keys().sorted()
  for each step in steps
    let needed: List of Text be dependencies.get(step) otherwise []
    for each need in needed
      if not dependencies.contains_key(need) then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: need)
      end
    end
  end

  let mutable placed: List of Text be []
  let mutable waiting: List of Text be steps
  repeat until waiting.is_empty()
    let mutable next: maybe Text be nothing
    for each step in waiting
      let needed: List of Text be dependencies.get(step) otherwise []
      let ready be for each need in needed all placed.contains(need)
      if ready then
        set next to step
        break
      end
    end
    match next
      when some(chosen) then
        set placed to placed.append(chosen)
        set waiting to for each step in waiting where step is not chosen collect step
      when nothing then
        fail with Cycle(remaining: waiting)
    end
  end
  return placed
end
